description: This file defines a React component named 'FeeSettingsPage' that provides a user interface for managing fee parameters such as base fee, per-mile fee, and after-hours multiplier. It fetches current fee settings from a data service, allows users to edit these parameters, and saves updates back to the data layer. The component includes form validation and user feedback messages.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to validate user input, invoke the data service to save updated fee parameters, and manages user feedback and loading state.
